_comment: W5 PAD probe, NEGATIVE leg (D86). Same machinery as dbgprobe-pad-plan.json but the op targets slot 3 - an INACTIVE record (active word 0; the 7j.16 loader marks parsed slots active=1 and stops at x==0xFFFF). capgen MUST fail loud ('not a loaded pad', naming slot 3) and exit non-zero; no capture transcript is written. The dbgprobe pad mode asserts exactly that.
